gotchas: Add to Cart starts disabled ("Loading inventory"); wait for it to enable. Then open /checkout/shopping_cart.jsp; shipping is pre-selected over store pickup.
Checkout Options: an Email box and "Checkout as Guest" (no account needed).

Shipping form fields carry no stable autocomplete/ids through the proxy; address them by accessible name (role=textbox[name="First Name"] etc.). A "Shipping, Surcharges & Fees" drawer can open and intercept: press Escape first.

Address verification: a multi-unit address without a unit is rejected ("Please check the apartment or unit number"); with a unit it shows "Unable to verify address" with a suggestion — click "Accept suggested address".

Payment: "Pay with Card" is pre-selected; Card Number, Expiration Date (MM/YY), CVV and Name on Card are plain inputs on the page. A hidden gift-card drawer also has a "Card Number" box, so use role selectors (visible only). Billing defaults to the shipping address. The next button is "Review Order" (a review step follows before the order is placed).

Verified 2026-10-06 through the proxy (US tunnel) with the public test card under a verification-only key: all four fields filled, no alert or aria-invalid. Stopped before Review Order. No bot wall seen.
